recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the bounded FHIR-14321 reconciliation for active Event/Request sources; handle Product/FiveWs terminology or future RequestStatus proposals only through separate work-group review or trackers.
issue_request: FHIR-14321 was Published/Persuasive and requested Event suspended to on-hold, Event aborted to stopped, Request suspended to on-hold, Request cancelled to revoked, plus revised definitions for Request revoked, Event not-done, and Event stopped.
initial_application: The issue was substantially applied historically by the 2018 workflow-pattern update and later source refactors: EventStatus and RequestStatus CodeSystem sources already carry the approved code names and definitions, and Request pattern metadata already uses on-hold/revoked. The remaining stale pieces were Event.status/Event.statusReason metadata and active Event mapping exception _pattern snapshots.
additional_context: The Zulip workflow status names thread supports the Jira rationale. Later RequestStatus-related decisions such as FHIR-15782 and FHIR-48861 explain why the current Request source is already correct and why no Request edit was needed. Inactive resource mapping exceptions and separate Product/FiveWs pattern text still containing older terms were not changed because they are outside FHIR-14321's active Event/Request scope.
